image.description: Tensor with shape [batch_size, h, w, d].
constraints: image = tf.reshape(tf.range(IMAGE_HEIGHT * IMAGE_WIDTH * CHANNELS, delta=1, dtype=tf.float32), shape=(BATCH_SIZE, IMAGE_HEIGHT, IMAGE_WIDTH, CHANNELS))

output.description: Pair of tensors (dy, dx) holding the vertical and horizontal image gradients (1-step finite difference).

constraints: Both output tensors have the same shape as the input: [batch_size, h, w, d]
The gradient values are organized so that [I(x+1, y) - I(x, y)] is in location (x, y)
dy will always have zeros in the last row
